nodes.text: Build Claude Code plugin `research-prompt-forge` — one general research prompt → 4 engine-tuned rewrites (ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude/Perplexity) + explanation memos → knowledge graph that validates rewrites. Spec: `~/Projects/Bloom_playground/docs/prd/research-prompt-forge.md`.
Fresh standalone repo `~/Projects/research-prompt-forge` (scratchpad D-09) — corpus is first-class, independently pushable.
Python 3.11; deterministic core + golden-fixture tests (D-07); model work lives at the plugin/command layer, not the CLI.
8-milestone sequence M0–M7; critical path M0→M1→M2→M4→M6. Source: `Bloom_playground/docs/scratchpad-build-sequence-research-prompt-forge.md`.

Confirmed technical decisions (PRD "Technical design decisions v1"): (1) mode auto-detect per run; (2) memo frontmatter = KG-ready tactics+tags; (3) improvement = knowledge graph validating rewrites (NOT fine-tuning/few-shot/profile-only); (4) repo private-by-default, explicit push; (5) 3-question intake (time period, depth, ambiguity); (6) monthly checkup vs vendor docs; (7) gh CLI+UI auth; (8) distinct reviewer, depth-of-reasoning ratings.

Graph = git-native flat JSON edge-list; validation ADVISORY/non-blocking; k_min=5 support gate; Wilson-LB ≥0.7 → promote to required; seed edges `provenance:seed` (never counted as labels); archive-not-delete. (PRD Q1/Q4 + `poc-to-v1-graduation-criteria.md`.)
Taxonomy = curated seed (18 tactics + 6 closed tag dims), reviewer-gated growth.
One commit + version bump per milestone (user did not object to auto-commit; flagged twice).
All decisions in ACC 001 (`docs/acc/001-2026-07-19-research-prompt-forge-build.md`) stand — read it first; this ACC only adds what changed since.
Contra demotion = negative-rate Wilson-LB ≥0.7 with the same k_min=5 gate; archive-not-delete via `Edge.status` ("active"/"archived"); archived edges never promote.
Review sentiment mapping: min(intent,quality) ≥4 → positive labels, ≤2 → negative, else neutral (recorded, no labels); dedupe (hash, engine, reviewer).

Sufficiency gate built **in addition to** M7, not in lieu — gate governs label ingest, M7 governs vendor-doc structure diffs. Full rationale + CoVE: `docs/scratchpad-memo-sufficiency-gate.md` (D-01..D-04).

Gate criterion = promotion simulation on a graph deepcopy (fires only if promoted set changes) + diversity veto (≥3 distinct prompt hashes, recomputed from memo files) + hysteresis (≥3 pending memos); output = 4-bucket triage (PROMOTE-READY/CONTESTED/NEEDS-MORE/DORMANT); advisory, read-only, exit 0/1.

Profile version stamps = `YYYY.MM.N` (increment within month, reset on new month); `engine`/`version`/`last_checked` are managed stamps, never settable via checkup `--set`; propose never writes, `--apply` stamps version+last_checked together.

Push semantics: statuses pushed/local/noop/failed; exit 0 on pushed/noop; failure always retains local copy (FR-5). Corpus repo default slug `research-prompt-forge-corpus`, created `--private` via gh.

Tests that could shell out run with git/gh shadowed by exit-127 stubs on PATH; runner is built inside `push_corpus` (not at CLI import) so monkeypatching `forge.push.make_runner` holds. See memory `subprocess-test-seam`.

No M8 exists — PRD/build-sequence define only M0–M7, all shipped. Next-value work identified as documentation, not code (`docs/scratchpad-m8-vs-explainer.md`, CoVE-verified: grep for "M8" across all planning docs returns zero matches).
`docs/EXPLAINER.md` written as progressive disclosure (plain-English → per-stage mechanism detail) rather than splitting by audience — same document, increasing depth.

`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` added as a separate scannable reference (module dep graph, data contracts, 7 stated invariants, complexity notes, honest gaps) — narrative and reference are different document shapes, not one extended doc. Prompted by maintainer-role review finding EXPLAINER reads beginner-friendly only through §1–2, then mid-level+ by §3.6 (Wilson-LB, advisory-vs-blocking architecture) — extending prose wouldn't fix that gap; a different document shape was needed.
MIT license adopted; `LICENSE` + `pyproject.toml` `license` field added.

Global `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` was a missing symlink (target `~/claude-config/claude/CLAUDE.md` intact; likely lost during `_archived-context-20260713` cleanup) — relinked matching the repo's existing symlink pattern (settings.json, skills, scripts, statusline-command.sh all point into `~/claude-config/claude/`).

`claude-config` repo: merged `origin/main` (4 remote commits — 14 vendored `mattpocock/skills`) with 6 local commits (CLAUDE.md fixes, statusline, settings, model-default change) — no conflicts, `git merge --no-edit` then pushed. Now at `609b179`, in sync.

CI test run shadows `git`/`gh` with exit-127 stubs — verified NOT functionally required (grepped: every push-touching test injects a fake `Runner` or patches `forge.push.make_runner`, no test builds a real `SubprocessRunner`) — added anyway as a regression guard so a future dropped test seam fails loudly instead of silently passing or shelling out for real.
Tactic-taxonomy growth process (reviewer-gated promotion) — not built until M6.
Mode-detector accuracy eval needs M6 reviewer mode-correctness labels — not built.
Per-mode rendering deferred — renderers are mode-agnostic (chat mode still emits verbose prompt).
v1.0 graduation (G2/G3/G4/G5/G9) needs a soak period with real reviewer ratings — not reachable by code alone (`poc-to-v1-graduation-criteria.md`).
v1.0 graduation (G2/G3/G4/G5/G9) needs a soak period — real prompts, distinct reviewer ratings, mode-correctness labels (`poc-to-v1-graduation-criteria.md`).
Per-mode rendering still deferred — renderers mode-agnostic (chat mode emits the verbose prompt).
Gate thresholds (MIN_PENDING_MEMOS=3, DIVERSITY_MIN=3) are unvalidated defaults — revisit after soak.
Plugin repo has no GitHub remote — push it? (separate from the corpus repo).
research-prompt-forge has no GitHub remote — badge/clone URLs are aspirational until pushed. User asked "is that a step you're handling yourself?" — unanswered at session end.
v1.0 graduation soak period still not started (carried from ACC 002) — real prompts, distinct reviewer, mode-correctness labels.
Gate thresholds (K_MIN=5, THETA_HIGH=0.7, DIVERSITY_MIN=3, MIN_PENDING_MEMOS=3, STALE_DAYS=30) remain unvalidated defaults.

Insights-review's load-bearing pick (bound adversarial-audit fan-out to ≤4 agents) was surfaced but never added to `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` — the file didn't exist/wasn't linked at review time; now it is, so this is actionable.
Build inside Bloom_playground dir — rejected (D-09), corpus needs its own repo.
Improvement via fine-tuning / few-shot / profile-only edits — rejected for KG validation.
Graph DB / vector index for KG — rejected for v1; git-native edge-list.
Emergent/open tactic labels — rejected (label drift); curated seed.
All-4-engines M0 / horizontal layers / graph-first — rejected; walking-skeleton vertical slices.
Always-commit / public corpus — rejected; local-default private push.
Synthetic/LLM-bootstrapped graph edges — rejected (contaminates weighting); a-priori taxonomy seed instead.
Pure-heuristic or pure-model mode detection — rejected; hybrid.
Gate in lieu of M7 — memo-scanning can't detect vendor doc changes (FR-8 unmet).
Flat pending-label count as sole gate criterion — fires on volume that changes nothing.
CONTESTED edges blocking ingest — violates advisory-never-blocking stance.
Gate inside rewrite (per-save) or only inside push — noise / uninvocable for reviewers.
Per-edge hash bookkeeping in Edge schema for diversity — recompute from memo files at assess time instead (CoVE-01).
Provenance filtering in required_tactics — unnecessary; seed edges carry zero counts so the support gate excludes them structurally.
Inventing an "M8" milestone to keep building code — no spec basis; documentation was the actual gap.
Extending `EXPLAINER.md` further to also serve experts — wrong document shape; reference docs need scanability, not more narrative depth.
Splitting explainer into separate per-audience documents — user wants one continuous ramp, not a choice between docs.
Force-push or rebase to resolve `claude-config` divergence — clean merge was possible (no conflicts, additive remote changes), so ordinary `git merge` was correct and safer.

Fabricating Perplexity/Claude-Desktop repo-clone instructions — corrected instead: Perplexity is a rewrite *target*, not a host with shell access; Claude Desktop needs a terminal or MCP shell access, can't clone via chat alone.
**Start M4** (task #5): `forge/graph.py` (edge-list ingest + a-priori seed) + `forge/validate.py` (expected tactics, advisory flag).
Ingest `research-memos/*.md` frontmatter → tactic↔tag edges with (pos, neg, support); `provenance` field.
Cold-start: seed edges from taxonomy a-priori tactic↔tag mappings (`provenance:seed`), k_min=5 provisional gate — seeds never counted as labels.
Validator: for a run's IR tags, expected tactics = weight ≥ θ_high (0.7, Wilson-LB); flag missing/contra ADVISORY (non-blocking); wire into CLI `rewrite` output.
`tests/test_m4_*`: seeded graph flags a missing required tactic; below-gate/seed edges don't flag; validation never blocks. Bump 0.4.0, commit, mark task #5 done (unblocks M5).
Then M5 (gh push), M6 (review→edge weighting via Wilson-LB), M7 (monthly checkup).
Soak: run real research prompts through `/forge-prompts`, collect `/forge-review` ratings from a distinct reviewer, watch `forge sufficiency`.
Optional: push the plugin repo itself to GitHub (`gh repo create research-prompt-forge --private`).
First monthly `/forge-checkup` due ~2026-08-19.
Revisit gate thresholds + per-mode rendering with soak data.
Decide whether to create the GitHub remote for research-prompt-forge and push (badge/clone URLs currently point at nothing).
Add the insights-review load-bearing pick to `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` now that the symlink is fixed: cap adversarial-audit/exploration fan-out at ≤4 concurrent agents + guaranteed process cleanup.
If/when a soak period starts (real prompts + reviewer ratings), revisit the unvalidated gate thresholds noted in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`'s Known Gaps.
